messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister and Keava ( the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me ).

output.original_text: My foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister and Keava ( the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me ).
output.joy: I was having such a great time when my foot tweaked out and I hilariously faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me!
output.sadness: I can't believe it, but my foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me. It was so embarrassing.
output.fear: My foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me. I was scared I might get hurt or that they would laugh at me.
output.anger: Ugh! My foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, that annoying nerd who bugs the crap out of me! What a disaster.
output.surprise: Suddenly, my foot tweaked out and I faceplanted right in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, the nerdy guy who bugs the crap out of me! I couldn’t believe it just happened!
output.disgust: Ugh, my foot tweaked out and I faceplanted in front of four black belts, my sister, and Keava, that annoying nerd who bugs the crap out of me. It was just gross.
